items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Sales knew it halfway right I believe he sang a chorus but I didn't hear it

ctx.x: so the guys didn't know it and let me see who started out playing it Frog Joseph was there I think maybe he knew the melody maybe he played the chorus the first and then Sales tried to yell out the chords to them and Sales knew it halfway right I believe he sang a chorus but I didn't hear it I heard everybody laughing there the audience and all too Sales would be thumping out the chords like B flat A flat and all of a sudden he said like say maybe C oh sorry sorry excuse me sorry he yelled out to everybody
